_comment: USD per 1,000,000 tokens, per model id exactly as the provider reports it.
Leave a model out (or set null) if you do not know its price - the
telemetry will then report TOKENS ONLY for it and mark cost as 'n/a',
Fill these in from your provider's pricing page before trusting the
dollar column. Models ending in ':free' are treated as zero automatically.
cached_input_per_mtok is optional; it defaults to input_per_mtok.
